descriptions.areas: Define rooms and areas to organize your devices in Home Assistant.
descriptions.binary_sensor: Binary sensors react to press and release events. Use them for simple on/off inputs like door sensors or motion detectors.
descriptions.event: Event entities handle button actions: single click, double click, and long press. Ideal for wall switches and buttons.
descriptions.output: Configure relay outputs to control lights, switches, and other devices.
descriptions.output_group: Group multiple outputs together to control them as a single entity.
descriptions.cover: Configure covers like blinds, shutters, and garage doors with open/close relays.
descriptions.modbus_devices: Add Modbus devices like energy meters, temperature sensors, and other RS485 equipment.
descriptions.sensor: Configure 1-Wire temperature sensors (DS18B20) connected to your device.
descriptions.adc: Configure analog-to-digital converter (ADC) sensors on BeagleBone Black pins.
descriptions.virtual_energy_sensor: Configure virtual energy and water sensors linked to outputs for Home Assistant Energy panel.
descriptions.template: Configure composite virtual entities like thermostats and alarm panels that combine sensors, inputs, and outputs.
descriptions.mcp23017: Configure I2C addresses of GPIO expanders. Default addresses are set automatically by board configuration. Change only if your board has different addresses.
descriptions.logger: Configure log levels for specific Python modules (e.g., boneio.modbus, pymodbus).
descriptions.boneio: boneIO configuration. If you want to change boneIO settings like device type or hardware version and load default working config, use the System State page!
descriptions.can: CAN bus configuration for inter-device communication via CANopen protocol.

template.alarm_codes_hint: Each user can have their own PIN code. The name is used in logs to identify who disarmed the alarm.
template.code_arm_required_hint: If enabled, a code must be entered to arm the alarm (managed by Home Assistant).
template.allow_frontend_control_hint: Disabled by default. Enable only if you use login.

gate_cover.mode_cycle_hint: Single relay — open → stop → close → stop. Most common for driveway and garage gates.
gate_cover.mode_separate_hint: Dedicated relays for open, close, and optionally stop.
gate_cover.mode_open_only_hint: Electric lock — each pulse opens, gate closes by itself. CLOSE/STOP commands are ignored.
gate_cover.pulse_duration_open_only_hint: Leave empty to hold relay on until the open sensor detects the door was opened (latch release mode).
